text: Tumor2Line reframes cancer cell-line selection population-aware alignment problem rather conventional pairwise nearest-neighbor search. tumors cell lines represent heterogeneous, incompletely overlapping biological landscapes, independent pairwise ranking fails capture broader population context. package provides two-component workflow: Shared Representation: Tumor lineage-compatible cell-line transcriptomes projected common low-dimensional PCA space. PCA built large-scale reference datasets (TCGA, TARGET, Treehouse, CCLE), enabling stable, reusable projection new samples—especially useful patient tumors available. PC scores standardized unit variance balance contributions high-variance microenvironmental signals subtle biological differences. Population-Aware Matching via uOT: Unbalanced optimal transport (uOT) aligns tumor cell-line populations shared space. Unlike independent pairwise similarity, uOT leverages distributional relationships populations relaxes strict mass-conservation constraints accommodate incomplete overlap. resulting transport plan yields ranked candidate cell lines per tumor. Validation: multi-level framework evaluates Tumor2Line via recovery experimentally matched pairs, molecular-state fidelity, independent functional validation using drug responses CRISPR gene dependencies. title: Population-Aware Tumor-Cell Line Alignment for Cancer Cell Line Selection
text: Tumor2Line transcriptomic framework population-aware alignment tumor-derived query samples candidate cancer cell lines. Query samples can include patient tumors, patient-derived organoids (PDOs), patient-derived xenografts (PDXs), organoids, tumor-derived models. Tumor2Line combines shared molecular representation lineage-aware unbalanced optimal transport (uOT) account population structure query samples candidate cell lines. produces ranked list candidate cell lines query sample. Overview Tumor2Line workflow Known tumor–cell-line pairs required run Tumor2Line. ground-truth pairs available, matching performance can evaluated using Top1 accuracy, Top3 accuracy, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), true-pair rank.

title: Population-Aware Tumor-Cell Line Alignment for Cancer Cell Line Selection
text: Population-aware matching tumor-derived query populations candidate cancer cell-line populations. Supports tumors, PDOs, PDXs, organoids, tumor-derived models. Provides cohort-specific PCA projection frozen external reference PCA space. Allows users build external reference PCA reuse subsequent datasets. Supports lineage-aware global candidate pools. Uses unbalanced optimal transport rather relying independent pairwise similarity. Reports raw transport_mass row-normalized matching_probability query–cell-line pair. Supports optional known-pair evaluation using Top1, Top3, MRR, true-pair rank. Supports single-new-query prediction adding projected query existing query population rerunning uOT (population mode).
